summary: Shows using klist.exe get cifs/<server> via win_command to confirm the session can obtain a delegated service ticket for a file server, noting the SPN prefix depends on the service (cifs, http, etc.).
questions: How do I test that Ansible can get a Kerberos ticket for a file server?
What SPN prefix do I use for file shares?

answer_card.title: Testing a delegated service ticket
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
ansible WINHOST -m ansible.windows.win_command -a 'C:/Windows/System32/klist.exe get cifs/fs.my.domain.com'
```

Success prints "A ticket to cifs/fs.my.domain.com has been retrieved successfully." Use the SPN prefix for the service: `cifs` for file shares, `http` for web services, etc.
